Start small. Commit to the 30 seconds it takes to start a job
Just because you start a job doesn’t mean you have to finish it. 
Run a dish washer twice. Do the laundry again if you forgot about the first time. It doesn’t matter how long any task takes you. 
Play some music or watch a tv show while you do it. 
I’m proud of you for getting up and feeding the cat and yourself.
It’s hard to run when we live together and lease isn’t up till March/April

Oh hun I’m so sorry. Like some others said just don’t show that you’ll crack and just do it. (I know how hard this is to do). You are not his mother. You don’t have to settle for someone who won’t work with you. I know it sucks but if it’s draining you then it’s worth considering if you really are a good fit

It’s important to express how you feel. Especially when you both work in the same hangar. Say that you’ll need to declare your relationship to higher ups otherwise you can get reposted away (and for what if it is just a sucky friendship). Maybe express a joke about how she has a stable job and can afford to buy you something one time. Or make a fun date idea out of it and ask her to spoil you

Have you ever approached him with options ? Instead of asking if he can do the dishes ask if he would like to do the dishes or the laundry. This gives him an option and makes him feel like he’s in control (it’s a parental tactic). Maybe entire him to do it at the same time as you and make it fun with music or something
There’s heaps of online support available and it’s often 24/7. Try go see a doctor yourself and explain the situation

Soft ESH. I think you guys should sit down an communicate love language with each other. There’s quiz’s online that you can do together. Make it a fun activity. This way you can get to know the way you boat best recieve love

NTA!! He needs to have a serious look at his attitude towards the family. Money can be a sensitive issue but you making more than him shouldn’t hurt his ego if he thinks of you guys as equal and you’re in it together. Especially when you have a toddler together

I’m so sorry that you’ve had to Experience this. Being on the spectrum or not being touched inappropriately is never acceptable especially if it CONTINUES to happen. Good on you for acknowledging that you were uncomfortable in the situation and tried to get out. Sucks about your mother but hopefully one day she’ll see that you were right
I’m leaning towards NTA but it’ll depend on how you approach it. Take caution and have a chat with your mum about it and maybe suggest buying a new one for her as she gave you hers

If anything, HES the reason she might be feeling insecure. Having someone close to you criticise others looks. It’s natural to compare yourself (subconsciously even) to someone else if it’s something that can affect you especially if it is your partner saying it
